mechanism: Spironolactone is a potassium-sparing diuretic and antimineralocorticoid that may reduce the efficacy of levonorgestrel-containing oral contraceptives through altered hepatic metabolism and competitive hormonal effects, while levonorgestrel may increase spironolactone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and contraceptive efficacy; consider additional contraceptive methods or alternative antimineralocorticoid therapy; counsel on signs of hyperkalemia.
